questions.question: In the xy-plane, which of the following does NOT contain any points (x, y) that are solutions to 7x + 4y > 12?
options: The region where x > 0 and y > 0
The region where x < 0 and y > 0
The region where x < 0 and y < 0
The region where x > 0 and y < 0
questions.explanation: If x < 0 and y < 0 then 7x + 4y < 0, which can never exceed 12; the other regions each contain solutions.

The given function g models the number of gallons of gasoline that remains from a full gas tank in a car after driving m miles. According to the model, about how many gallons of gasoline are used to drive each mile?

Each 3.0-ounce serving of cheddar cheese and each 1.2-ounce serving of tuna provides about 1 microgram of vitamin B12. If a total of 1.7 micrograms of vitamin B12 are consumed from eating x ounces of cheese and y ounces of tuna, which equation best represents this situation?
questions.explanation: Cheese gives 1/3.0 ≈ 0.33 micrograms per ounce and tuna gives 1/1.2 ≈ 0.83 micrograms per ounce.

An arborist measured and recorded the heights of red maple trees in a certain area. Of the red maple tree heights recorded in this area, the minimum was 42 feet and the maximum was 57 feet. Which inequality is true for all possible values of t, where t represents the recorded height, in feet, of a red maple tree in this area?
questions.explanation: Every recorded height is between the minimum 42 and the maximum 57.

One of the equations in a system of two linear equations is given, where n is a positive constant. The system has no solution. Which equation could be the second equation in this system?
questions.explanation: The given equation is x − y = 2n. A line with the same slope but a different intercept, such as x − y = n (2x − 2y = 2n), gives no solution.

questions.question: How many solutions does the equation 10(x + 15) + 5x = 15(x + 10) have?
questions.explanation: Both sides simplify to 15x + 150, so every x is a solution.

questions.question:
|4x − 3| = −9
How many solutions does the given equation have?
questions.explanation: An absolute value is never negative, so |4x − 3| = −9 has no solution.

questions.question: Which of the following expressions is equivalent to 11x<sup>10</sup> − 11x<sup>9</sup> + 77x?
questions.explanation: Factor out the common factor 11x: 11x(x^9 − x^8 + 7).

−x<sup>2</sup> + bx − 64 = 0. In the given equation, b is an integer. The equation has no real solutions. What is the least possible value of b?
questions.explanation: No real solutions means b^2 − 256 < 0, so −16 < b < 16. The least integer is −15.

questions.question: An object moves at a speed of 350 feet per second. What is this speed, in yards per second? (3 feet = 1 yard)

A marine biologist is studying a habitat that contains shoal bass, a species of freshwater fish. The box plot shown summarizes the lengths, in centimeters (cm), of a sample of 70 shoal bass from this habitat. What is the range, in cm, of the lengths of the shoal bass in the sample?
questions.explanation: The minimum is 34 cm and the maximum is 49 cm, so the range is 49 − 34 = 15.

questions.question:
f(x) = 24(2)(x/6)
Which table gives four values of x and their corresponding values of f(x) for the given exponential function?
questions.explanation: f(−6) = 24(1/2) = 12, f(0) = 24, f(6) = 48, f(12) = 96, which matches only choice B.

questions.question: In the xy-plane, circle M is the graph of the equation (x − 3)<sup>2</sup> + (y − 6)<sup>2</sup> = 4. Circle P has the same center as circle M but has a radius that is twice the radius of circle M. Which equation represents circle P?
questions.explanation: Circle M has radius 2, so circle P has radius 4 and r^2 = 16, with the same center (3, 6).

questions.question: In triangle JKL, cos y° = 3132. What is the length of KL?
questions.explanation: In right triangle JKL, cos y° = KL/JL = KL/32 = 31/32, so KL = 31.

questions.question: The height of a right circular cylinder is 6 inches longer than its radius, and the surface area of the cylinder is 1,080π square inches. What is the cylinder's radius, in inches?
questions.explanation: With radius r and height r + 6, 2πr(r + 6) + 2πr^2 = 1,080π, so r(2r + 6) = 540, giving r^2 + 3r − 270 = 0 and r = 15.

questions.question: In triangle RST, angle T is a right angle, point L lies on RS, point K lies on ST, and LK is parallel to RT. If the length of RT is 63 units, the length of LK is 21 units, and the area of triangle RST is 630 square units, what is the length of KT, in units?
questions.explanation: The area gives ST = 2(630)/63 = 20. Triangles SKL and STR are similar with ratio 21/63 = 1/3, so SK = 20/3 and KT = 20 − 20/3 = 40/3.

A linear model estimates the population of a city from 1995 to 2019. The model estimates the population was 59 thousand in 1995, 217 thousand in 2015, and x thousand in 2019. To the nearest whole number, what is the value of x?
questions.explanation: The rate is (217 − 59)/20 = 7.9 thousand per year. In 2019: 217 + 4(7.9) = 248.6, or about 249.

questions.explanation: The whole graph lies below the x-axis (it levels off near y = −5 and then falls), so it never crosses y = 0.

questions.question: x<sup>2</sup> + y = 21 and −x + y = 1. The solutions to the given system of equations are of the form (x, y). What is a possible value of x?
questions.explanation: Subtracting gives x^2 + x = 20, so (x + 5)(x − 4) = 0 and x = −5 or 4. Only −5 is listed.

questions.question: How many times does the graph of the given equation y = 9(a6)x + c − b cross the x-axis, where a, b, and c are positive constants such that a > 6 and b > c?
questions.explanation: Since a > 6, the base a/6 is greater than 1, so the graph rises from the asymptote y = −b (below the axis) to infinity, crossing the x-axis exactly once.

questions.question:
(2x − 7)2 − 8(2x − 7) + 15 = 0
What is a solution to the given equation?
questions.explanation: Let u = 2x − 7: u^2 − 8u + 15 = (u − 3)(u − 5) = 0, so 2x − 7 = 3 or 5, giving x = 5 or x = 6.

questions.question: −(3x − 7)<sup>2</sup> = p + 17. In the given equation, p is an integer constant. The equation has no real solution. What is the least possible value of p?
questions.explanation: The left side is never positive, so there is no solution when p + 17 > 0, i.e. p > −17. The least integer is −16.

questions.question: The function p is defined by p(x) = a(x − 1)2 + b, where a and b are constants. If p(0) = 10 and p(3) = 19, what is the value of p(−1) + p(5)?
Charles saves 35 of the $225 he earns each week from his summer job. If Charles continues to save at this rate, how much money, in dollars, will Charles save in 3 weeks?
questions.explanation: Each week he saves (3/5)(225) = 135 dollars, so in 3 weeks he saves 3 × 135 = 405 dollars.

The table summarizes the distribution of age and assigned group for 120 participants in a study. One of these participants will be selected at random. What is the probability of selecting a participant from group A, given that the participant is at least 10 years of age?
questions.explanation: 80 participants are at least 10, and 18 + 7 = 25 of them are in group A: 25/80 = 5/16.

questions.question: The composition of an animal is defined as the muscles, bones, and fat of the animal. A scientist studied the composition of one young swamp buffalo and determined the buffalo had 139.2 kilograms of muscle, which made up approximately 67.7% of its composition. Of the remaining composition of this buffalo, approximately 51.4% was bone, and the remainder was fat. Based on these approximations, to the nearest tenth, how many kilograms of this buffalo's composition was bone?
questions.explanation: The total is 139.2 / 0.677 ≈ 205.6 kg, so the remaining 32.3% is about 66.4 kg. Bone is 51.4% of that, which is about 34.1 kg.

questions.question: A science club from a certain high school in Ohio conducted an experiment to study the effects of smell on taste. A sample of 100 students was selected at random from the high school to participate in the experiment. First, the students tasted a pureed food sample while wearing covered goggles and nose plugs. Then, the students tasted the same pureed food sample without nose plugs. 35 students were able to correctly identify the pureed food sample while wearing nose plugs. Which of the following is the largest population to which the results of the experiment can be generalized?
options: All students from the high school
The 100 students who participated in the experiment
The 35 students who were able to correctly identify the pureed food sample while wearing nose plugs
All students from high schools in Ohio
questions.explanation: The sample was random from this one high school, so results generalize only to all students of that school.

questions.explanation: Moving right 4 units changes the center from (7, −3) to (11, −3).

questions.question: In triangle ABC, the measure of angle A is 52° and AC = 40. In triangle PQR, the measure of angle P is 52° and PR = 120. Which additional piece of information is sufficient to prove that triangle ABC is similar to triangle PQR?
options: The measures of angle B and angle R are 40° and 88°, respectively.
The measures of angle B and angle Q are 52° and 40°, respectively.
questions.explanation: With B = 40° and R = 88°, angle C = 180° − 52° − 40° = 88° = R, and angle Q = 40° = B, so the triangles are similar by AA.
